ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.BypassValidationRules__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c , "Yes"), ISBLANK(StartDate__c) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c , "No"), ISBLANK(EndDate__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date is required when Status is Yes. End Date is required when Status is No.
